_note: Single source of truth for every outbound platform link that could ever become a referral or affiliate link. `url` is the plain official site (the fallback, always kept). When a program approves us, paste the tracked link the platform issues into `affiliateUrl` (that is the ONLY field to change); the site then uses it automatically, marks the link as a referral link, and the disclosure page updates. Leave `affiliateUrl` empty until approved. Never invent referral or tracking IDs. All partner links render with rel="sponsored nofollow noopener".
